# CR-9208: Acme Manufacturing credit limit increase to $650,000

**Decision: APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION.** Acme is eligible for $650,000 on its own standing. Michael Torres cannot approve it himself. It needs approval from **Elena Novak** (Director of Finance) and concurrence from **David Morgan** (Chief Revenue Officer), who stands in for the VP Sales because Torres submitted the request.

## 1. The request
- **Request:** CR-9208, ERP customer C-1001, raising the limit from $250,000 to $650,000.
- **Date and requestor:** dated 2026-09-23, submitted by Michael Torres (VP Sales).
- **Basis: standard.** The justification is the third-plant ramp-up. It does not rely on the parent guarantee, and the limit is within Acme's own tier maximum anyway.
- **Not in the ERP extract:** `credit_requests.csv` does not contain CR-9208. I have relied on the record you supplied.
- **Overlapping request:** CR-9201 (Sarah Chen, $250,000 → $400,000, same date, same customer) is also Pending Approval. The two should be reconciled so only one limit is set.

## 2. The customer
These records all refer to the same company. The ERP name, CRM account and legal documents match on DUNS 04-812-7730 and the Milwaukee address:
- ERP C-1001 Acme Mfg. Holdings
- CRM-2048 Acme Manufacturing, **Strategic** tier

This is not Acme Industrial Supply Co. (C-1044 / CRM-2091), which is a different company.

## 3. The policy
**CREDIT-POLICY-2026** is the policy in force on 2026-09-23.

The "Strategic Account Delegation" (CREDIT-POLICY-2026-DEL1) is **not in the OWM register**, so it is not an approved governing document. It gives Torres no authority.

## 4. Payment history
The rule is that no invoice may be paid or unpaid more than 30 days past due, for invoices due 2025-09-23 to 2026-09-23. Acme passes.

| Invoice | Due | Paid | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-60412 | 2025-11-28 | 2025-11-24 | Paid early |
| INV-62011 | 2026-07-25 | 2026-07-22 | Paid early |
| INV-62305 | 2026-10-02 | Unpaid | Not yet due on the request date |

## 5. Maximum limit
- The Strategic tier maximum is **$750,000**, so $650,000 is within it without any credit support.
- GRT-ACME-2026 ($400,000) does name C-1001 and is in force, but it is not needed for this request.

## 6. Requestor authority
The VP Sales has **no credit approval authority** under CREDIT-POLICY-2026. Torres also cannot approve a request he submitted.

## 7. Required approvers
- **Approval:** a limit over $500,000 needs the Director of Finance, **Elena Novak** (EMP-402).
- **Concurrence:** a Strategic account over $500,000 needs the VP Sales. That is Torres, the requestor, so the concurrence passes to his manager, **David Morgan**, Chief Revenue Officer (EMP-300).

```json
{
  "outcome": "APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION",
  "request": {"id": "CR-9208", "customer": "Acme Mfg. Holdings (ERP C-1001; CRM-2048 Acme Manufacturing; DUNS 04-812-7730)", "current_limit": 250000, "requested_limit": 650000,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Michael Torres (VP Sales)", "basis": "standard"},
  "eligibility": {"status": "eligible", "maximum_limit": 750000,
                  "basis": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026 Strategic tier maximum (CRM-2048 tier Strategic); no invoice due 2025-09-23 to 2026-09-23 paid or unpaid more than 30 days late; guarantee GRT-ACME-2026 not relied on", "late_invoices": []},
  "authority": {"policy": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": 0,
                "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Director of Finance, with VP Sales concurrence (Strategic account over $500,000)",
                "approvers": [{"name": "Elena Novak", "role": "Director of Finance", "kind": "approval"},
                              {"name": "David Morgan", "role": "Chief Revenue Officer (requestor's manager, in place of VP Sales under separation of duties)", "kind": "concurrence"}]},
  "evidence": ["CR-9208 request record as supplied (Northstar ERP)", "OWM register of approved governing documents", "credit_policy_2026.md (CREDIT-POLICY-2026)", "structured/customers.csv (C-1001)", "structured/crm_accounts.csv (CRM-2048, Strategic)", "structured/erp_invoices.csv (INV-60412, INV-62011, INV-62305)", "structured/erp_credit.csv (C-1001 limit 250000)", "structured/employees.csv and organization_chart.md (Torres VP Sales, reports to David Morgan; Elena Novak Director of Finance)", "credit_policy_2026_delegation.md disregarded: not in OWM register", "acme_parent_guarantee.md (GRT-ACME-2026) noted but not relied on"],
  "missing_evidence": ["CR-9208 does not appear in structured/credit_requests.csv; overlapping pending request CR-9201 (C-1001, $400,000) should be reconciled"]
}
```
